overall_summary: The sample size is relatively small with low view counts overall, but 'self respect' topics combined with phone-related action hooks (like deleting chats, hiding status, or unpinning) show slightly higher baseline views (e.g., AfaLxMy6FMY at 40 views, rwOUYo_hayQ at 36 views, wFimeeP_aVc at 32 views) compared to abstract emotional topics like 'अधूरी मोहब्बत' or general late-night thoughts.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on concrete phone UI actions related to self-respect (e.g., 'उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी', 'स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर उन्हीं का नाम था') performed better, averaging around 30-40 views.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on micro-actions involving smartphone interfaces and boundary-setting.

weak_patterns.evidence: General atmospheric hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' or 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' received lower engagement (5-12 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely atmospheric openings unless tied to a specific tangible smartphone interaction or decision.

next_video.reason: Leverages the winning self-respect and privacy-setting pattern that outperformed other abstract emotional categories in previous uploads.

experiment: Testing if privacy settings (read receipts / blue ticks toggle) drive higher retention and views within the proven self-respect category.
